issues.description: The problem statement requires implementing calc_val so that it returns the value 42 in the EAX register, but the solution implementation places 42 in EBX (mov ebx, 42) and comments that it returns in EBX. This contradicts the explicit specification of the return register and would confuse students who follow the problem's requirement or use the solution as a reference.
issues.suggested_fix: Modify the solution implementation so calc_val returns 42 in EAX. For example, in solution_repository/helloWorld.asm replace 'mov ebx, 42' with 'mov eax, 42' and update the comment to indicate the return is in EAX. (Alternatively, if EBX was intentional, update the problem statement to require the value in EBX—preferred fix is to make the solution match the stated requirement.)

issues.description: Problem statement requires a function `calc_val` that returns the value 42 in the EAX register, but the solution implementation of `calc_val` places the value in EBX (mov ebx, 42). This is a mismatch in the intended return register (EAX vs EBX) for the same conceptual entity (the function's return value), which will confuse students mapping the requirement to the reference implementation and may lead them to believe the solution is incorrect or that EAX is not required.
issues.suggested_fix: Modify the solution's calc_val implementation to return the value 42 in EAX (e.g., replace `mov ebx, 42` with `mov eax, 42`) so it matches the problem statement's requirement.
